inlines.v: IMPEARL, verb transitive imperl'. [in and pearl.] To form in the resemblance of pearls. --Dew-drops which the sun IMPEARLs on every leaf, and every flower. 1. To decorate with pearls, or with things resembling pearls. The dews of the morning impearl every thorn.
